steps.title: The Director
steps.body: Cinematics are directed like a film shoot: cast actors, set marks, give instructions, place and cut cameras, then add dialogue, music, sound and effects on the timeline.

steps.title: A reward scene
steps.body: “New reward scene” makes a complete example: a fade in, a title, a character walks up and speaks, three camera shots, music and a cheer. Scrub the timeline to see any moment in the camera preview.

steps.title: Camera from view
steps.body: Orbit the stage (left view) to frame a shot, move the playhead, then Camera from view adds a camera there. Shots cut, or blend when Blend is above zero. Record (●) makes the selected role walk where you click.
steps.task: Add a camera with “Camera from view”.

doItForMe.click: [aria-label="Director tools"] button[title="A camera at the playhead from the stage view"]

steps.title: Trigger the scene
steps.body: Anything can start a scene: a zone, an asset interaction, a screen button, a gate (On arrive), a clip marker, or logic. Here, the trigger zone you drew plays it when the hero walks in.
steps.task: Make your trigger zone play the cinematic (Scene › select the zone › When the hero walks in › Play cinematic).
